saving.w_sample: Sample, kept only while you look around
saving.w_sample_tip: Nothing here is your own work. Leave the sample and it is cleared
saving.w_ok: In this browser and your “{name}” folder
saving.w_ok_at: Every save goes to both. Last saved to the folder at {time}
saving.w_saving_tip: Your work is already in this browser
saving.w_ask: Only in this browser. “{name}” needs a click to reconnect
saving.w_ask_tip: Chrome needs your OK to use the folder again. Choose “Allow on every visit” and it won’t ask next time
saving.w_lost: Only in this browser. Can’t reach “{name}”
saving.w_full: Only in this browser. The disk with “{name}” is full
saving.w_room: Only in this browser. This browser is out of room, so “{name}” can’t catch up
saving.w_lost_tip: It’ll catch up by itself as soon as the folder is back

saving.w_decide.one: One thing to decide about your folder
saving.w_decide.other: {n} things to decide about your folder

saving.w_checking: Checking where your work is kept…
saving.w_drive: Backed up in your Google Drive
saving.w_drive_tip: Every change also goes to Grading Studio’s own hidden folder in your Google Drive
saving.w_none: Not backed up. Only in this browser
saving.w_none_tip: Clearing this browser’s data would erase your work. Choose a folder and every save goes there too
saving.w_none_nopick: Clearing this browser’s data would erase your work. This browser can’t save to a folder, so make a take-home file when you finish marking
saving.f_linked_about: A copy of your papers, marks, scores, comments, rosters and rubrics is kept here, with no save button to remember. If this browser is ever cleared, link the folder again and everything comes back.
saving.f_inside: It is in a folder called “{root}” inside “{name}”.
saving.f_about: Choose a folder on this computer once, and every save goes there as well as to this browser, with a copy of each day to go back to. Choose something private: it holds student work. When Chrome asks, choose “Allow on every visit”. If you already have a Grading Studio folder, choose it and your work comes back.
saving.f_stop_text: What’s already in the folder stays there. Nothing in it is deleted. Your work carries on in this browser, with no second copy.
saving.f_stopped: Not saving to a folder any more. The folder’s files are still there.
saving.f_bad: That folder couldn’t be used. Try another one.
saving.f_done: Done. Your work now saves to “{name}” as well.
saving.f_reopened: Newer work from your folder came in, so this download has been reopened.
saving.f_all_back: Everything came back from your folder.

saving.f_came.one: Newer work from your folder came in for one student.
saving.f_came.other: Newer work from your folder came in for {n} students.

saving.f_lost: Some files your folder lists aren’t in it any more, or are damaged, so they couldn’t come back. This affects: {list}. Your marks, scores and comments are all here. To get papers back, drop the same download in again.
saving.hist_about: The folder keeps a copy of each day, and one before anything big. Going back puts your marks, scores, comments, late files, readings, rosters and settings back to how they were then. Papers stay.
saving.hist_none: No copies in the folder yet. The first one is made today.
saving.hist_nofolder: Link a folder and it keeps a copy of each day to go back to.
saving.hist_q: Go back to this copy from {when}?
saving.hist_text: Your marks, scores, comments, late files, readings, rosters and settings go back to how they were then, in this browser and in the folder. Papers stay. A copy of how things are now is made first, so this can be undone.
saving.hist_failed: That didn’t finish. Your work may be partly back: use Put back on the newest safety copy below.
saving.safe_about: A whole copy of your work is kept in this browser before anything risky, such as bringing work in, going back in time or a new year. The newest three are kept. Papers aren’t in them, since they never change.
saving.safe_q: Put back the safety copy from {when}?
saving.safe_text: Everything goes back to how it was then, and anything added since goes. Papers stay, so a download opened since keeps its row with no marks. How things are now is kept first, so this can be undone.
saving.cf_intro: These aren’t the same in this browser and in your folder, so nothing was chosen for you. Until you decide, each place keeps its own.
saving.cf_each: Please choose a version for each one first.
saving.cf_gone: This download was forgotten, but one copy has work on it from after that.
saving.cf_setup_note: Scores stay saved either way. Totals and percents follow the one you pick.
saving.cf_rows_diff: These two copies don’t have the same rubric rows, so each shows its own.
saving.cf_one_student: A file goes to one student
saving.part_vrot: Videos turned the right way up
saving.part_carry: Flags on new and changed files
saving.c_about: Grading on another computer, or moving to a new one? Make a take-home file here and bring it in there. The same goes for the trip back.
saving.c_sample: This is the sample, so there is nothing of yours to carry yet.
saving.take_about: Makes one protected file with everything you need to grade on another computer: student files, marks, scores, comments, rosters, rubrics, readings, Word edits, added files and strong examples. Your planning goes too: lessons, units, timetable and their files.
saving.pass_about: Choose a passphrase of a few words. If you forget it, nobody can open this file, you included, but your work here isn’t affected. Keep the file somewhere private all the same.
saving.pass_short: Please use at least 8 characters. A few ordinary words work well.
saving.take_lack: No papers for: {list}. This browser isn’t keeping them, so only the marks and scores will be in the file. To take the papers too, drop each of those downloads in here first.
saving.take_done: Done: {name} ({size}). Open Grading Studio on the other computer and use Bring work in. The same goes for the trip back.
saving.take_done_lack: Its papers aren’t in the file for: {list}. Only the marks and scores went. You’ll need those downloads on the other computer.
saving.take_fail: The file didn’t finish, so it isn’t usable. Your work here is fine. Please try again, somewhere with more room.
saving.take_where: That file couldn’t be written there. Try another place.
saving.bring_pass: Type the passphrase for {name}. The whole file is checked before anything here changes.
saving.e_notours: That isn’t a Grading Studio take-home file.
saving.e_notbackup: That isn’t a Grading Studio backup.
saving.e_pass: That passphrase doesn’t open this file. Check it and try again. If you’re sure of it, the file may be damaged. Nothing here has changed.
saving.e_damaged: This file is damaged, or it’s been changed since it was made, so it can’t be trusted. Nothing here has changed. Make a new one if you can.
saving.e_newer: This file was made by a newer copy of Grading Studio. Nothing here has changed. Reload this page to get the newest copy, then try again.
saving.b_nothing: Nothing to bring in: what’s here already has everything in this file.
saving.b_changed: Changes to downloads you have here

saving.b_come.one: One student comes in from the file
saving.b_come.other: {n} students come in from the file

saving.b_stay.one: One student stays the same here, because this copy is newer
saving.b_stay.other: {n} students stay the same here, because this copy is newer

saving.b_extra.one: One file changes: late files, readings or Word edits
saving.b_extra.other: {n} files change: late files, readings or Word edits

saving.b_set.one: One setting comes in from the file
saving.b_set.other: {n} settings come in from the file

saving.b_gone_a: Forgotten on the other computer, so it’s removed here too

saving.b_lib.one: One change to classes, units or rosters
saving.b_lib.other: {n} changes to classes, units or rosters

saving.b_bank: Saved comments from the other computer are added to yours
saving.b_school: School resources added or changed on the other computer
saving.b_other: Rubrics or settings you don’t have here yet

saving.b_ex.one: One example comes in or changes

saving.b_plan_all: Your planning comes in, with its units, timetable and files. Link its folder again if you use one.

saving.b_plan.one: One lesson, file or setting your planning here doesn’t have
saving.b_plan.other: {n} lessons, files or settings your planning here doesn’t have

saving.b_same.one: One download has nothing to bring in.
saving.b_same.other: {n} downloads have nothing to bring in.

saving.b_room: This browser may not have room: it needs about {need} and has about {room}.
saving.b_safe: A safety copy of how things are now is made first, so you can undo this below.
saving.b_asks_intro: These changed both here and in the file. Choose the one you want for each.
saving.b_again: Work changed in another window while this was open, so there’s something new to choose. Nothing has been brought in yet.
saving.b_full: This browser ran out of room, so that didn’t finish. Your marks and scores here weren’t replaced. Free up some disk space and try again.
saving.b_small: This browser’s small store for rosters and settings is full, so that didn’t finish. Your marks and scores here weren’t replaced.
saving.b_fail: That didn’t finish. Your work is safe, and a safety copy was made first: Put back is below if anything looks wrong.

saving.rm_text.one: This removes all student work from this browser: one download with its papers, marks, scores and comments, plus rosters, units, rubrics, late files, readings, Word edits, school resources, examples and safety copies.
saving.rm_text.other: This removes all student work from this browser: {n} downloads with their papers, marks, scores and comments, plus rosters, units, rubrics, late files, readings, Word edits, school resources, examples and safety copies.

saving.rm_never: You haven’t made a take-home file from this browser, so anything done here may not be anywhere else.

saving.rm_newer.one: One download has changes since your last take-home file ({when}). Those changes aren’t in that file.
saving.rm_newer.other: {n} downloads have changes since your last take-home file ({when}). Those changes aren’t in that file.

saving.rm_after: Your last take-home file was made {when}, after your last change.
saving.rm_folder: Your linked folder “{name}” isn’t touched: its files stay where they are, and this browser stops saving to it.
saving.rm_plan: Planning work isn’t touched. This can’t be undone.
saving.rm_fail: Not everything could be removed. Close any other Grading Studio windows and try again.
saving.y_about: Your classes carry on into a fresh year with empty class lists. First, everything from this year goes into one protected file, and the file is checked before anything here is cleared.

saving.y_cards.one: One class, with its units and assignment cards. Each card keeps its rubric and its Quick mark boxes. No papers, scores or comments.
saving.y_cards.other: {n} classes, with their units and assignment cards. Each card keeps its rubric and its Quick mark boxes. No papers, scores or comments.

saving.y_dates: Due dates and term dates, a year later
saving.y_plan: Planning units and the semester, a year later. This year’s lessons move to Past lessons, ready to reuse.
saving.y_roster: Class lists, only for classes that keep the same students. Otherwise they are left empty and the watch list is cleared.
saving.y_stays: Your settings, grading scale, saved rubrics and comment bank stay as they are.

saving.y_leave.one: One set of papers goes into the file and leaves this browser.
saving.y_leave.other: {n} sets of papers go into the file and leave this browser.

saving.y_pass_about: Choose a passphrase of a few words. Nobody can open the file without it, you included, so write it down somewhere safe.
saving.y_names: Give both years a name, like 2025–26 and 2026–27.
saving.y_same: The new year needs a different name from the one you are closing.
saving.y_go: Save the file and start the new year
saving.y_check_fail: The file didn’t read back the same as your work here, so it can’t be trusted. Nothing here was changed. Please try again, somewhere with more room.
saving.y_fail: The file didn’t finish, so nothing here was changed. Please try again, somewhere with more room.
saving.y_start_fail: The new year didn’t finish setting up. Everything from {year} is safe in {file}, and a safety copy was made first: Put back is below if anything looks wrong.
saving.y_started_text: Your classes, units and assignment cards are ready. Paste each class’s students on its Students tab if the lists are empty. Everything from {from} is in {file} ({size}), checked. Keep it somewhere safe with its passphrase. Open an archived year brings it back.

saving.y_open_text.one: The file holds one set of papers, with its classes, class lists, marks and scores, made {when}.
saving.y_open_text.other: The file holds {n} sets of papers, with their classes, class lists, marks and scores, made {when}.

saving.y_open_first: Opening it puts that year in place of what is here now. First, {now} is saved to its own file with the same passphrase, and checked, so you can switch back the same way.
saving.y_open_plan: Planning is not changed: last year’s lessons are already in Past lessons.
saving.y_open_folder: This browser stops saving to the folder “{name}”, which keeps the current year.
saving.y_open_fail: That didn’t finish. {now} is safe in {file}, and a safety copy was made first: Put back is below. Reload before doing anything else.
saving.ask_h: Choose where your work is kept
saving.ask_text: Right now your marking lives only in this browser, and clearing the browser’s data would erase it. Choose a folder on this computer once. Every save then goes there too, with a copy of each day to go back to. Nothing is uploaded.
saving.ask_none_h: Your work is not backed up
saving.ask_later_done: The sidebar keeps saying “Not backed up” until a folder is chosen. Click it any time.
saving.bad_not: Your latest marks and scores are NOT saved.
saving.bad_partly: Your latest marks and scores are only partly saved, in this browser’s small quick copy.
saving.bad_how: The browser wouldn’t store them, often because the computer is out of space. Keep this window open, free up some space, and press Try again.
saving.bad_over: Saved. Your work is safe again.
saving.ask_have: Already have a Grading Studio folder? Choose it and your work comes back.
saving.gb_cant: That copy couldn’t be read. If your folder is on a drive that was unplugged, plug it in and try again.
saving.gb_none: None of the assignments in this browser now were in this copy.
saving.gb_all: To take everything back to how it was then:
saving.gb_done: “{name}” is back to how it was at {when}.
saving.gb_undone: Undone. “{name}” is as it was before.
saving.gb_undo_bad: That couldn’t be undone here. The copy made just before restoring is on this page.
saving.gb_room: This computer is out of room, so nothing was restored.
saving.gb_failed: That didn’t finish, so nothing was restored.
saving.mv_h: Grading Studio is moving to a new address
saving.mv_stays: Work saved in this browser stays at this address. It does not move by itself.
saving.mv_s1: Press Take my work with me and save the file. It holds your grading work and your Planner.
saving.mv_s3: There, in Settings, Saving and sync, press Bring work in and choose the file.
saving.mv_soon: Please do this soon: this address will stop working. A linked folder can be linked again at the new address too.
